blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Find the values of \(x\) and \(y\): \(x + iy + 2 - 3i = i(5 - i)(3 + 4i)\).
blocks.explanation:
Dekhiye, yeh equality (barabri) wala sawal hai: bayen taraf ek complex number hai aur dayen taraf doosra, aur dono ko barabar kaha gaya hai.
Diya kya hai? Left side par \(x + iy + 2 - 3i\) aur right side par teen cheezon ka product \(i(5 - i)(3 + 4i)\).
Find kya karna hai? Do real numbers \(x\) aur \(y\).
Kaunsa rule? Equality of complex numbers: do complex numbers tabhi barabar hote hain jab un ke real parts bhi barabar hon aur imaginary parts bhi. Yahi rule do alag equations de dega.
Plan: pehle right side ko multiply kar ke seedha \(a + ib\) form mein layenge, phir left side ke real aur imaginary hisse alag karenge, aur aakhir mein dono parts ko aamne saamne rakh kar compare karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x + iy + 2 - 3i = i(5 - i)(3 + 4i)\), aur \(x, y\) real numbers hain.
Humein find karna hai: real numbers \(x\) aur \(y\).
Tareeqa: Equality of complex numbers: agar \(a + ib = c + id\) ho to \(a = c\) aur \(b = d\). Yeh rule yahan isliye fit hota hai kyunke simplify karne ke baad dono sides ek ek complex number ban jati hain, aur phir hum real ko real se aur imaginary ko imaginary se mila sakte hain. Is tarah ek equation se do equations mil jati hain, aur do unknowns ke liye do equations hi chahiye hoti hain.

Right side ke do brackets multiply karein
\[(5 - i)(3 + 4i)\]
\[= 15 + 20i - 3i - 4i^2\]
\[= 15 + 17i + 4\]
\[= 19 + 17i\]
Kyun: Teen cheezon ka product ek saath karna mushkil hai, is liye pehle do brackets ko multiply karte hain. Pehle bracket ka har term doosre bracket ke har term se multiply hota hai (jaise algebra mein \((a + b)(c + d)\) karte hain). \(20i - 3i = 17i\) like terms hain. Aur \(i^2 = -1\) hai, is liye \(-4i^2 = -4(-1) = +4\) ban jata hai jo real number hai aur 15 ke saath jur jata hai.
Dhyan dein: Bohat se students \(-4i^2\) ko \(-4\) likh dete hain. Yaad rakhiye, minus ko minus se multiply karein to plus banta hai.

Ab \(i\) se multiply karein
\[i(19 + 17i) = 19i + 17i^2\]
\[= 19i - 17\]
\[= -17 + 19i\]
Kyun: Bahar wala \(i\) bracket ke dono terms se multiply hota hai: \(i \cdot 19 = 19i\) aur \(i \cdot 17i = 17i^2 = -17\). Aakhir mein hum real part \(-17\) ko pehle likhte hain taake number standard \(a + ib\) form mein aa jaye; is form mein real aur imaginary part seedha nazar aate hain aur compare karna aasaan ho jata hai.

Left side ko group karein
\[x + iy + 2 - 3i\]
\[= (x + 2) + i(y - 3)\]
Kyun: Left side mein chaar terms bikhre hue hain. Kyunke \(x\) aur 2 dono real hain, in ko ek bracket mein rakha: \((x + 2)\) real part hai. \(iy\) aur \(-3i\) dono ke saath \(i\) hai, in se \(i\) common nikala: \(i(y - 3)\), to \(y - 3\) imaginary part hai. Yeh grouping isi liye zaroori hai ke left side bhi \(a + ib\) shakal mein aa jaye.

Real aur imaginary parts compare karein
\[(x + 2) + i(y - 3) = -17 + 19i\]
\[x + 2 = -17\]
\[x = -19\]
\[y - 3 = 19\]
\[y = 22\]
Kyun: Ab dono sides ek jaisi shakal mein hain. Equality of complex numbers ke mutabiq real part real part ke barabar: \(x + 2 = -17\), is liye \(x = -17 - 2 = -19\). Imaginary part imaginary part ke barabar: \(y - 3 = 19\), is liye \(y = 22\). Ek complex equation ne humein do aam linear equations de di hain.
Dhyan dein: Imaginary part \(19\) hai, \(19i\) nahi; \(i\) ko equation mein mat likhiye.

Tasdeeq: values wapas rakh kar dekhein
\[-19 + 22i + 2 - 3i\]
\[= -17 + 19i \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Achhe students hamesha jawab check karte hain. \(x = -19\) aur \(y = 22\) left side mein rakhne se \(-19 + 2 = -17\) aur \(22i - 3i = 19i\) mila, yani \(-17 + 19i\), jo bilkul right side hai. Is liye hamara jawab pakka sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x = -19,\ y = 22\)
Yani left side mein yeh values rakhne se dono taraf ek hi complex number \(-17 + 19i\) ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Find the values of \(x\) and \(y\): \((x + iy)(1 - i) = (2 - 3i)(-5 + 5i)(-i3/5)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh bhi equality ka sawal hai, lekin is dafa \(x + iy\) akela nahi balkay \((1 - i)\) se multiply ho kar aaya hai.
Diya kya hai? Right side par teen factors ka product hai; kitab ka \((-i3/5)\) asal mein \(-\frac{3i}{5}\) hai.
Find kya karna hai? Real numbers \(x\) aur \(y\).
Rule kaunsa? Pehle \(x + iy\) ko akela karna hai, jis ke liye \(1 - i\) se divide karna parega. Complex number se divide karne ka tareeqa conjugate se multiply karna hai, kyunke is se denominator real ban jata hai.
Plan: right side simplify, phir conjugate ki madad se divide, aur aakhir mein parts compare.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \((x + iy)(1 - i) = (2 - 3i)(-5 + 5i)(-i3/5)\); \((-i3/5)\) ka matlab \(-\frac{3i}{5}\) hai.
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) aur \(y\).
Tareeqa: Pehle right side ke teen factors ka product nikalenge. Phir \(x + iy\) ko akela karne ke liye dono taraf \(1 - i\) se divide karenge. Divide karne ke liye upar neeche conjugate (ulta sign wala saathi) \(1 + i\) se multiply karte hain, kyunke \((1 - i)(1 + i)\) real number deta hai, aur real number se divide karna bilkul aasaan hai.

Right side ke pehle do factors multiply karein
\[(2 - 3i)(-5 + 5i)\]
\[= -10 + 10i + 15i - 15i^2\]
\[= -10 + 25i + 15\]
\[= 5 + 25i\]
Kyun: Har term ko har term se multiply kiya: \(2(-5) = -10\), \(2(5i) = 10i\), \((-3i)(-5) = 15i\), aur \((-3i)(5i) = -15i^2\). Kyunke \(i^2 = -1\), \(-15i^2 = +15\) real ho gaya aur \(-10\) ke saath mil kar 5 bana. \(10i + 15i = 25i\).
Dhyan dein: \((-3i)(-5)\) mein do minus milte hain to plus \(15i\) aata hai; yahan sign ki ghalti bohat aam hai.

Teesre factor se multiply karein
\[(5 + 25i)\left(-\dfrac{3i}{5}\right)\]
\[= -3i - 15i^2\]
\[= 15 - 3i\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{3i}{5}\) bracket ke dono terms se multiply hota hai: \(5 \times (-3i/5) = -3i\) (5 cancel ho gaya), aur \(25i \times (-3i/5) = -15i^2 = +15\). Real part pehle likha. Ab poora sawal itna simple ho gaya hai: \((x + iy)(1 - i) = 15 - 3i\).

\(1 - i\) se divide karein
\[x + iy = \dfrac{15 - 3i}{1 - i}\]
\[= \dfrac{(15 - 3i)(1 + i)}{(1 - i)(1 + i)}\]
Kyun: \(x + iy\) ko akela karne ke liye dono sides ko \(1 - i\) se divide kiya. Lekin denominator mein \(i\) ho to fraction ko \(a + ib\) mein nahi tor sakte. Is liye upar aur neeche dono ko conjugate \(1 + i\) se multiply kiya. Upar neeche ek hi cheez se multiply karna asal mein 1 se multiply karna hai, is liye value bilkul nahi badalti, sirf shakal badalti hai.
Dhyan dein: Conjugate mein sirf \(i\) wale part ka sign badalta hai: \(1 - i\) ka conjugate \(1 + i\) hai, \(-1 + i\) nahi.

Upar aur neeche simplify karein
\[(1 - i)(1 + i) = 1 - i^2 = 2\]
\[(15 - 3i)(1 + i)\]
\[= 15 + 15i - 3i - 3i^2\]
\[= 18 + 12i\]
\[x + iy = \dfrac{18 + 12i}{2}\]
\[= 9 + 6i\]
Kyun: Neeche \((a - b)(a + b) = a^2 - b^2\) wala formula laga: \(1 - i^2 = 1 - (-1) = 2\), jo real hai, yahi conjugate ka faida tha. Upar har term multiply kiya; \(-3i^2 = +3\) real ho kar 15 ke saath 18 bana, aur \(15i - 3i = 12i\). Phir dono parts ko 2 se divide kar diya.

Parts compare karein
\[x + iy = 9 + 6i\]
\[x = 9,\quad y = 6\]
Kyun: Ab left side \(x + iy\) aur right side \(9 + 6i\) dono \(a + ib\) shakal mein hain. Equality of complex numbers ke mutabiq real parts barabar (\(x = 9\)) aur imaginary parts barabar (\(y = 6\)).

Tasdeeq: wapas multiply karein
\[(9 + 6i)(1 - i)\]
\[= 9 - 9i + 6i - 6i^2\]
\[= 15 - 3i \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Asal equation mein \(x + iy\) ko \(1 - i\) se multiply kiya gaya tha, is liye check ke liye hum bhi \(9 + 6i\) ko \(1 - i\) se multiply karte hain. \(-6i^2 = +6\), to \(9 + 6 = 15\) aur \(-9i + 6i = -3i\). Wohi \(15 - 3i\) mila jo right side ka simplified form tha, is liye jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x = 9,\ y = 6\)
Yani \(x + iy = 9 + 6i\) hai, jo \(1 - i\) se multiply ho kar right side ka \(15 - 3i\) deta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Find the values of \(x\) and \(y\): \(\frac{x}{2 + i} + \frac{y}{3 - i} = 4 + 5i\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein \(x\) aur \(y\) fractions ke upar baithe hain aur neeche complex numbers hain.
Diya kya hai? Do fractions ka jama \(4 + 5i\) ke barabar hai.
Find kya karna hai? Real numbers \(x\) aur \(y\).
Rule kaunsa? Jab tak denominator mein \(i\) hai, real aur imaginary part alag nazar nahi aate. Is liye har fraction ko uske denominator ke conjugate se multiply kar ke rationalise (denominator ko real banana) karenge, phir equality of complex numbers lagayenge.
Plan: dono fractions rationalise, real aur imaginary parts ikatthe, compare kar ke do linear equations, aur unhein saath solve.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(\frac{x}{2 + i} + \frac{y}{3 - i} = 4 + 5i\), \(x, y\) real hain.
Humein find karna hai: \(x\) aur \(y\).
Tareeqa: Har fraction ko uske denominator ke conjugate se upar neeche multiply karenge (rationalise karna), taake neeche real number aa jaye. Phir har fraction real part + imaginary part mein toot jayega. Equality of complex numbers se do simultaneous linear equations (aisi do equations jo saath saath solve hoti hain) milengi.

Pehla fraction rationalise karein
\[\dfrac{x}{2 + i} = \dfrac{x(2 - i)}{(2 + i)(2 - i)}\]
\[= \dfrac{x(2 - i)}{4 + 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{2x}{5} - \dfrac{x}{5}i\]
Kyun: \(2 + i\) ka conjugate \(2 - i\) hai. Neeche \((2 + i)(2 - i) = 4 - i^2 = 4 + 1 = 5\), jo real number hai. Ab upar \(x(2 - i) = 2x - xi\) hai, aur 5 se divide kar ke hum fraction ko saaf do hisson mein tor sakte hain: real part \(\frac{2x}{5}\) aur imaginary part \(-\frac{x}{5}\).

Doosra fraction rationalise karein
\[\dfrac{y}{3 - i} = \dfrac{y(3 + i)}{(3 - i)(3 + i)}\]
\[= \dfrac{y(3 + i)}{9 + 1}\]
\[= \dfrac{3y}{10} + \dfrac{y}{10}i\]
Kyun: Isi tarah \(3 - i\) ka conjugate \(3 + i\) hai, aur \((3 - i)(3 + i) = 9 - i^2 = 10\). Upar \(3y + yi\) ko 10 se divide kiya to real part \(\frac{3y}{10}\) aur imaginary part \(\frac{y}{10}\) mila.
Dhyan dein: \(4 - i^2\) ko \(4 - 1 = 3\) mat likhiye; \(-i^2 = +1\) hai, is liye jawab 5 aata hai.

Jama kar ke parts compare karein
\[\text{Real: } \dfrac{2x}{5} + \dfrac{3y}{10} = 4\]
\[\text{Imag: } \dfrac{y}{10} - \dfrac{x}{5} = 5\]
Kyun: Dono fractions ko jama karte waqt real parts aapas mein aur imaginary parts aapas mein jurte hain. Yeh jama \(4 + 5i\) ke barabar hai, is liye equality of complex numbers ke mutabiq real parts ka jama 4 aur imaginary parts ka jama 5 hona chahiye. Is tarah do equations mil gayin.

Fractions khatam karein
\[4x + 3y = 40 \quad (1)\]
\[-2x + y = 50 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: Fractions ke saath hisaab mein ghalti ka khatra hota hai. 5 aur 10 ka LCM 10 hai, is liye dono equations ko 10 se multiply kiya: \(\frac{2x}{5} \times 10 = 4x\), \(\frac{3y}{10} \times 10 = 3y\), \(4 \times 10 = 40\). Doosri equation mein \(\frac{y}{10} \times 10 = y\) aur \(-\frac{x}{5} \times 10 = -2x\). Ab poore numbers hain aur kaam aasaan hai.

Dono equations solve karein
\[\text{From (2): } y = 50 + 2x\]
\[4x + 3(50 + 2x) = 40\]
\[10x + 150 = 40\]
\[x = -11\]
\[y = 50 + 2(-11) = 28\]
Kyun: Substitution method use kiya: equation (2) mein \(y\) akela karna sab se aasaan tha, \(y = 50 + 2x\). Isay (1) mein rakha to sirf \(x\) wali equation bachi: \(4x + 150 + 6x = 40\), yani \(10x = -110\), \(x = -11\). Phir \(x\) wapas rakh kar \(y = 50 - 22 = 28\) mila.

Tasdeeq: values wapas rakhein
\[\dfrac{-11}{2 + i} = \dfrac{-22 + 11i}{5}\]
\[\dfrac{28}{3 - i} = \dfrac{42 + 14i}{5}\]
\[\text{Sum} = \dfrac{20 + 25i}{5}\]
\[= 4 + 5i \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: \(x = -11\) aur \(y = 28\) asal fractions mein rakhe. Pehla fraction \(\frac{-11(2 - i)}{5}\) aur doosra \(\frac{28(3 + i)}{10} = \frac{14(3 + i)}{5}\) bana. Dono ka jama \(\frac{20 + 25i}{5} = 4 + 5i\), bilkul right side. Jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x = -11,\ y = 28\)
In values se dono fractions ka jama theek \(4 + 5i\) banta hai.
